author: claude

patch.value: Defeats both the single-window release attribution path and the all-release-tags path it mirrors. Only the padded git-tag spelling worked, which is discoverable nowhere: package.json, the generated heading, and the release version flag all use the unpadded form.
Release attribution silently fails when the release tag is zero-padded but the version is not

normalizeReleaseKey only stripped a leading v and lowercased, so release spellings were compared literally. Calendar release tags are commonly zero-padded (v2026.06.07) while the SAME release is spelled unpadded in package.json, in the release version flag, and in the rendered heading. An item declaring release 2026.6.7 therefore failed to match the window built from the padded tag and silently fell through to Unreleased.

an item declaring the unpadded version attributes to a window built from the padded tag and vice versa; calendar -N disambiguators and semver prereleases still compare exactly so 2026.6.2 does not match 2026.6.2-1; both the single-window and all-release-tags paths honour the canonicalized key; output unchanged for workspaces that never set the field

message: Create Issue item for zero-padded release key mismatch

value.author: claude
value.text: Reproduction and proof, on real fleet data: set pm-csv-69ln (fix shipped in v2026.06.07, tracker closed 2026-07-24) to release 2026.6.7 — the spelling shown in its own CHANGELOG heading and package.json — regenerated pm-csv's changelog, and the item landed under '## Unreleased'. Re-setting the field to the padded 2026.06.07 placed it correctly under '## 2026.6.7 - 2026-06-07', isolating the cause to literal key comparison. After this fix the unpadded spelling also lands under '## 2026.6.7 - 2026-06-07'. Gates: npm run build OK, 179/179 tests pass (5 new).

patch.value: An item declaring an unpadded version attributes to a window built from the padded tag and vice versa, while calendar -N disambiguators and semver prereleases still compare exactly.
Verified 2026-07-28: canonicalPendingTagName reconciles padded and unpadded tag names and both the single-window and all-release-tags paths consume the canonicalized key.
Shipped and verified 2026-07-28. Closing the tracker; forced past a stale assignment to a retired agent identity.
